title: AccessPolicy
description: Contract 10: per-operation permission model for exposing GraphRAG operations through MCP/HTTP. Roles are resolved from a bearer token: 'admin' when the token matches GRAPHRAG_ADMIN_TOKEN (compared in constant time), otherwise the default role. Write operations fail closed when no admin token is configured, and every check returns an auditable PermissionResult.

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0'.

default_role.description: Role assumed when no admin token is presented.

admin_role.description: Role granted by a valid admin token.

allow_anonymous.description: Operations permitted for the default role (reads, formatting, federation, evaluation, subscription).

allow_admin.description: Additional operations permitted for the admin role (ingestion, update, delete, admin status).

PermissionDecision.description: The auditable outcome of a permission check.

PermissionResult.description: Outcome of a permission check, populated for every call.

reason.description: Human-readable justification, including why a denial happened.
